sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर् र्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥ ८- ७॥
iast:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca
mayyarpitamanobuddhir māmevaiṣyasya saṃśayaḥ 8-7
translation: Therefore, at all times, remember Me, and fight, with mind and intellect fixed (or absorbed) in Me; you shall doubtless come to Me alone.
